## What kind of change is this?

- [ ] Iteration (new version / variable movement)
- [ ] Variable evidence
- [ ] Transcription fix (brings a canonical file closer to the authored original)
- [ ] Docs / navigation / tooling (no change to canonical text)
- [ ] Adoption registry entry

## Variable movement (for iterations)

- **Narrows:**
- **Held open (named, not filled):**
- **Newly opened (per Gödel):**
- **Forcing Test outcome class:** forced-fill / live hypothesis / stipulation / proven-open

## Honesty checklist

- [ ] Loads the current version as substrate; nothing prior is lost or silently overwritten.
- [ ] Does **not** fill a held-open variable with assumption.
- [ ] Does **not** claim more than is forced (no promoting a live hypothesis to a law).
- [ ] Base code unchanged — or an architectural addition is logged explicitly as a departure.
- [ ] Updated the Iteration Ledger (`framework/registers.md`) and `CHANGELOG.md` (if a version/variable change).
- [ ] Updated deep-link anchors in `framework/*.md` if any canonical heading was renamed.
